info.title: NeoRuneExtended - C# mods for Minecraft Dungeons II
info.description: The NeoRuneExtended command line: read mod logs (neorunex log), check your setup (neorunex doctor), disassemble packages, and dump and diff the game's API after a patch.

options.name: --mod
options.description:
[--install] [--game <game folder>] [--tools <dir with retoc/repak>]
[--title <name>] [--version <x.y>] [--author <name>] [--author-url <url>]
[--description <text>]   (the Mods tab of Blueprint Loader 2.0)
[--images <dir>]   (PNG/JPG files packed into the mod for NeoRune.Images)
[--bindings <NeoRune.Game.json>]  (warns NR0003 if the game is another build)
